claims.text: The driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival geofence for 195 seconds and no longer. POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds for the STANDARD zone class, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' tap, so the anchor clause of this category fails on its own arithmetic and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails on the same facts. The trip was terminated by the driver at 19:44:40, before the required dwell could elapse: counting from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:41:20 the five minutes ran out at 19:46:20, and even on the driver's own 'arrived' marker at 19:41:35 the clock would not have expired until 19:46:35. The trip record's own wait_time_min of 3.1 — 185 seconds between arrived_at and cancelled_at — is the driver's own record that he did not serve the mandatory wait he is charging the rider for.

POL-NS-06 then decides the money. The effective in-geofence dwell is 195 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum — a shortfall of 105 seconds — and the clause is strict: the fee is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages. The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line only, SGD 4.00, which EV-FARE-00203 shows as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00; that figure reconciles with both the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (each SGD 4.00), so no integrity defect under POL-NS-08 is in play and the whole contested amount is the amount that must come back to the filing rider under POL-GEN-03.

The driver cannot repair the shortfall by accumulating separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i). There is only one in-geofence interval in the trace — a single 21-fix qualifying run, run_count 1 — so there is no second interval for the limb to add. The limb also requires a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covering the pickup road, and none exists: EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING with weight 0.00, and under POL-GEN-02 a missing artifact carries no fact and can only be cited as an absence. Limb (i) is therefore unavailable and the 105 second shortfall stands untouched.

This case does not turn on proximity, and the rider does not pretend otherwise: the trace carries 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius with reported accuracy between 5 and 11 m, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and the driver genuinely reached the pin. That is exactly why the fee fails — the rider's SGD 4.00 bought a five-minute wait, and the driver served 195 seconds of it.

Any suggestion that the rider was simply absent is contradicted by the rider's own track: all 60 of the rider's fixes are qualifying, and every one sits between 36.4 m and 51.6 m of the pickup pin (mean 42.8 m), comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius set by POL-NS-04(c). The rider's entitlement to the refund does not depend on this, because POL-NS-06 refunds on the shortfall regardless of presence, but it disposes of any no-show narrative built on the rider being somewhere else.

The chat log corroborates the premature termination in the driver's own words: the rider messaged 'wait ah, i coming liao' at 19:42:50, and the driver answered at 19:44:31 with 'cannot wait already ah, cancelling', nine seconds before the 19:44:40 cancellation, at a moment when the longest in-geofence run of 195 seconds was still 105 seconds short of the mandatory 300. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00203 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY — the rider's message is code-switched and genuinely contestable. That ambiguity goes only to whether the rider meant 'on my way' or 'already here'; on no reading does it add a single second to the driver's dwell, so the point survives the discount, and the cancellation timestamp it corroborates is independently carried by the unimpaired trip record.

No driver compensation is payable on this ruling. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; here POL-NS-01 fails at limbs (c) and (d) and POL-NS-06 applies directly to the shortfall, so the SGD 3.20 appearing in the fare breakdown's derived money block is not owed, and the SGD 4.00 belongs to the rider rather than to the driver.

claims.text: The driver genuinely reached the pickup pin and stood there: the GPS trace shows 21 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class, with a closest approach of 18.7 m — far more than the 3 consecutive clean fixes POL-NS-02 demands — so arrival under POL-NS-02 is established on a clean, weight-1.0 trace and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied.

The rider cannot take refuge in POL-NS-04. Limb (a) is not cleanly made out, because the only wait-window message, MSG-00203-002 ('wait ah, i coming liao'), is contested Singlish and the chat log is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY. Limb (b) fails outright: that message was sent at 19:42:50 and the driver replied at 19:44:31, 101 seconds later, inside POL-NS-04's 120-second window. This claim rests on the message timestamps, not on the contested wording, so it survives the 0.85 discount.

The arrival marker is not false. The 'arrived' event at 19:41:35 falls 15 seconds inside the driver's own stationary in-geofence run, so at the marker he was inside the 50 m radius and not moving; neither POL-NS-05 trigger — more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or above — is met, and no false-arrival referral arises against the driver.

The driver does not dispute the arithmetic that decides this case. His continuous in-geofence dwell was 195 seconds, 105 seconds short of the 300-second STANDARD minimum in POL-NS-01 limb (c), so the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable and POL-NS-06 requires that fee line to be refunded in full. The accumulation route under POL-NS-06 limb (i) is closed because the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), and no POL-NS-07 compensation can arise because that clause requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full. The driver's conduct was nonetheless diligent: he arrived at the pin, held position, and replied to the rider before cancelling, so nothing beyond the refund of the fee line is warranted.

ruling.explanation: To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider, and no driver compensation is payable. The fee stands or falls on POL-NS-01, which needs all four of its conditions. Two are met. The driver did arrive: the GPS trace EV-GPS-00203 (weight 1.0) shows 21 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius with the closest approach 18.7 m, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and limb (b) holds. The trip record EV-TRIP-00203 (weight 1.0) records a driver cancellation with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, as limb (d) requires. But the case fails on the arithmetic of limb (c). Measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:41:20 and not from the 'arrived' tap, the driver's longest continuous in-geofence dwell was 195 seconds (EV-GPS-00203) against the 300-second STANDARD minimum in POL-NS-01 limb (c) - a shortfall of 105 seconds. Limb (d) fails with it, because the trip was terminated at 19:44:40, before the five minutes could run out (the clock would not have expired until 19:46:20); the trip record's own wait_time_min of 3.1 minutes is the driver's own record of the abbreviated wait. POL-NS-06 then decides the money, and it is strict: where the effective in-geofence dwell falls short of the minimum the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages. The sum to return is the cancellation-fee line only - SGD 4.00, shown as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 in EV-FARE-00203 (weight 1.0), which reconciles with the fee schedule because the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee are both SGD 4.00, the greater-of rule producing SGD 4.00 with no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d). The driver's points are accepted. The arrival marker was not false: at the 19:41:35 'arrived' event the driver was stationary inside the 50 m radius, 15 seconds into his in-geofence run, so neither POL-NS-05 trigger (more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or more) is met and no false-arrival referral arises against him under POL-NS-05(ii). The accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) cannot rescue the fee: there is only one in-geofence interval (run_count 1), and limb (i) also requires a present and populated traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT - EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the limb is unavailable rather than satisfied. POL-NS-04 is not the route to this refund: the driver replied to the rider's 19:42:50 message at 19:44:31, 101 seconds later and inside the 120-second window, so limb (b) of that clause fails and the clause does not apply; the refund rests on the dwell shortfall, not on rider contact. The rider's presence is not in dispute - all 60 rider fixes sit between 36.4 m and 51.6 m of the pin (mean 42.8 m), inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius - but the outcome does not depend on it. The chat log EV-CHAT-00203 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY; it corroborates that the driver cancelled as the rider was asking him to wait ('cannot wait already ah, cancelling' at 19:44:31, nine seconds before the 19:44:40 cancellation), but the cancellation timestamp it shows is independently carried by the weight-1.0 trip record, so no part of this ruling rests on the impaired artifact and the finding survives the discount. No driver compensation: POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and here limb (c) fails and POL-NS-06 applies directly, so the SGD 3.20 in the fare breakdown's derived money block is not owed and the SGD 4.00 belongs to the rider. The figures used are the 195-second dwell, the 300-second STANDARD minimum, the 105-second shortfall and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee. Confidence is 0.90: the deciding facts are carried by the weight-1.0 GPS trace, trip record and fare breakdown, and no artifact that decides the case is impaired. No referral is produced - no clause in this category directs one on these facts.

ruling.explanation:
This ruling is addressed to both parties. The disputed sum is the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee recorded in EV-FARE-00203 (cancellation_fee 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). That fee is refunded to the rider in full.

On arrival, both sides agree and the evidence is clear. EV-GPS-00203 (weight 1.0, unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage) shows the driver held position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for 21 qualifying fixes, closest approach 18.7 m, well beyond the 3 consecutive clean fixes POL-NS-02 requires. The driver genuinely reached the pin, and his 'arrived' event at 19:41:35 falls 15 seconds inside his own stationary run, so POL-NS-05 raises no false-arrival issue and no POL-NS-05(ii) referral arises.

The fee nonetheless fails on POL-NS-01 limb (c). The continuous in-geofence dwell is 195 seconds (19:41:20 to 19:44:35), against the 300-second STANDARD minimum; the clock runs from the first qualifying fix, not from the 'arrived' tap. That is a shortfall of 105 seconds. Limb (d) fails with it: the driver terminated the trip at 19:44:40 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, before the required dwell had elapsed (five minutes from 19:41:20 would have run out at 19:46:20, and even from the 'arrived' marker at 19:46:35 — the trip record's own wait_time_min of 3.1 is the driver's record that the mandatory wait was not served). POL-NS-06 is strict liability on the waiting period: the fee is refunded whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages.

The driver's argument that the shortfall might be repaired by summing separate intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is rejected. The trace contains a single in-geofence run (run_count 1), so there is no second interval for the limb to add, and the limb in any event requires a present and populated traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covering the pickup road. EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) and its absence is load-bearing: it confirms no such advisory exists and, per POL-GEN-02, a missing artifact carries no fact.

No driver compensation is payable. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. POL-NS-01 fails here and POL-NS-06 governs, so the SGD 3.20 shown in the fare derived money block is not owed. The anti-farming check does not trip either (driver no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4).

On the rider's conduct: POL-NS-04 is not the ground of this refund and the driver correctly showed it does not apply — the rider's message at 19:42:50 was answered at 19:44:31, inside the 120-second window, which defeats limb (b). The point does not matter, because POL-NS-06 does not depend on rider conduct. For completeness, the rider's own track (EV-GPS-00203) places her device within 42.8 m mean of the pin for all 60 fixes, inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, so there is no basis for a no-show narrative against her.

On evidence weight: EV-CHAT-00203 carries a schema-level IMPAIRED tag at weight 0.85 with issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY. That tag does not meet any limb (a) to (d) of POL-NS-08 — its message count matches trip_record.chat_message_count, there is no gap, and the ambiguity goes only to the rider's phrasing, which cannot add a second to the dwell — so it is a POL-GEN-02 down-weighting only, and the ruling does not rest on it. The deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-00203 and EV-TRIP-00203, both at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below 1.0 and no POL-NS-09 escalation is triggered.

Outcome: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 is returned to the rider, no compensation is paid to the driver, and the charge is not to be read as a rider win against a driver who did everything except serve the full waiting period that the fee purchases.

ruling.explanation: Both of you agree on the arithmetic, and the record agrees with you. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00203, weight 1.0) shows the driver genuinely reached the pin at Blk 267 Tampines St 21: 21 clean fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, closest approach 18.7 m, so arrival under POL-NS-02 is proved and limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied — the rider does not dispute this and I accept it. But POL-NS-01 requires the driver to hold position inside the geofence for a continuous 300 seconds for a STANDARD pickup, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:41:20 and not from the 'arrived' tap, and the trace shows him there for 195 seconds only — a shortfall of 105 seconds. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00203, weight 1.0) says the same in its own numbers: arrived 19:41:35, cancelled by the driver 19:44:40, wait_time 3.1 minutes (about 185 seconds), cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The termination came before the five minutes could run out, so limb (d) also fails. POL-NS-06 then decides the money, and it is strict: on a shortfall the cancellation fee is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages. The sum returned is therefore the cancellation-fee line only, SGD 4.00 (EV-FARE-00203, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), which reconciles with both the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee of SGD 4.00 each — no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect is in play — and that is the whole contested amount, so the refund is full. The rider's presence (all 60 rider fixes qualifying, 36.4 m to 51.6 m from the pin, mean 42.8 m, well inside the 100 m STANDARD radius) and the driver's diligence in reaching the pin and replying do not alter that; the fee fails on the wait alone. The arrival marker is not false: at 19:41:35 the driver was 15 seconds into a stationary run inside the 50 m radius, so neither POL-NS-05 trigger (more than 300 m from the pin, or 15 km/h or above) is met and no false-arrival referral arises. The rider's POL-NS-04 argument is immaterial: the driver replied to the rider's message within 120 seconds (rider 19:42:50, driver 19:44:31, 101 seconds), so that clause would not apply in any event, and the refund does not depend on it. Accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) cannot help the driver: there is only one in-geofence interval (run_count 1), and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so nothing permits separate intervals to be summed and the shortfall stands at 105 seconds. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and here POL-NS-06 applies directly; the SGD 3.20 shown in the fare breakdown's derived money block is not owed and the SGD 4.00 belongs to the rider. On weight: the chat log EV-CHAT-00203 is impaired at weight 0.85 with issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY (the rider's code-switched message), but nothing in this outcome rests on it — POL-NS-06 is strict liability on the waiting period, so the ambiguity goes only to what the rider meant and adds no seconds to the dwell; the finding survives the discount because the deciding figures are carried by the weight-1.0 GPS trace and trip record, and my confidence is set on those. No escalation is engaged: there is no direct conflict between admissible artifacts on arrival, dwell or rider presence; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations in 30 days against 131 completed trips, below both the absolute and rate thresholds, and the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is context only); rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the POL-NS-09(d) threshold of 3; the counterparty-dispute counts are 0; and no single impaired artifact carries the deciding fact. No referral arises, because no clause that produces one fires here.

ruling.explanation: Both sides agree on the decisive arithmetic, and the tribunal finds as follows. The driver accepted the job at 19:35:10 and reached the pickup pin at Blk 267 Tampines St 21 — a STANDARD zone. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00203, weight 1.0) shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 195 seconds, from 19:41:20 to 19:44:35, held inside the 50 m arrival radius. POL-NS-01 requires a minimum wait of 300 seconds for a STANDARD pick-up, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. The driver cancelled at 19:44:40 (EV-TRIP-00203), 105 seconds short of that minimum. POL-NS-01 limb (c) therefore fails, and limb (d) fails with it because the trip was terminated before the required dwell had elapsed. The fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-06 governs the money: a 105-second shortfall against a strict 300-second minimum means the cancellation fee is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages. The accumulation route in POL-NS-06(i) does not rescue the fee — there was only one in-geofence interval (run_count 1), and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so that limb is unavailable. AMOUNT: the contested amount is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.00 in EV-FARE-00203, shown CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. That figure reconciles with both the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect arises, and the full SGD 4.00 is returned to the rider. DRIVER COMPENSATION: none. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent (SGD 3.20) only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; it is not, and POL-NS-06 applies directly, so the SGD 3.20 shown in the fare breakdown's derived money block is not owed. ON THE REMAINING CLAIMS: the driver did reach the pin — 21 qualifying fixes, closest approach 18.7 m — so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and this is not a proximity case; the rider's own track (all 60 fixes within 36-52 m of the pin, mean 42.8 m) sits inside POL-NS-04's 100 m presence radius, but the refund depends on neither point. The driver's arguments that POL-NS-04 is unavailable (the driver replied within 120 seconds) and that the arrival marker is not false (the marker falls 15 seconds inside the stationary in-geofence run) are both accepted; neither changes the outcome. The chat log EV-CHAT-00203 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY; it corroborates the driver's own 'cancelling' message nine seconds before termination, but the deciding dwell figure is carried independently by the unimpaired GPS trace and trip record, so the discount does not move the result. One rider claim was discarded at the mechanical stage for citing the MISSING advisory without naming its issue code. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged and no clause produces a referral.

ledger.claim: The driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival geofence for 195 seconds and no longer. POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds for the STANDARD zone class, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' tap, so the anchor clause of this category fails on its own arithmetic and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails on the same facts. The trip was terminated by the driver at 19:44:40, before the required dwell could elapse: counting from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 19:41:20 the five minutes ran out at 19:46:20, and even on the driver's own 'arrived' marker at 19:41:35 the clock would not have expired until 19:46:35. The trip record's own wait_time_min of 3.1 — 185 seconds between arrived_at and cancelled_at — is the driver's own record that he did not serve the mandatory wait he is charging the rider for.

POL-NS-06 then decides the money. The effective in-geofence dwell is 195 seconds against the 300 second STANDARD minimum — a shortfall of 105 seconds — and the clause is strict: the fee is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider answered messages. The sum to be returned is the cancellation-fee line only, SGD 4.00, which EV-FARE-00203 shows as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00; that figure reconciles with both the STANDARD zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (each SGD 4.00), so no integrity defect under POL-NS-08 is in play and the whole contested amount is the amount that must come back to the filing rider under POL-GEN-03.

The driver cannot repair the shortfall by accumulating separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i). There is only one in-geofence interval in the trace — a single 21-fix qualifying run, run_count 1 — so there is no second interval for the limb to add. The limb also requires a present and populated traffic_advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covering the pickup road, and none exists: EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING with weight 0.00, and under POL-GEN-02 a missing artifact carries no fact and can only be cited as an absence. Limb (i) is therefore unavailable and the 105 second shortfall stands untouched.

ledger.claim: This case does not turn on proximity, and the rider does not pretend otherwise: the trace carries 21 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD radius with reported accuracy between 5 and 11 m, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied and the driver genuinely reached the pin. That is exactly why the fee fails — the rider's SGD 4.00 bought a five-minute wait, and the driver served 195 seconds of it.

Any suggestion that the rider was simply absent is contradicted by the rider's own track: all 60 of the rider's fixes are qualifying, and every one sits between 36.4 m and 51.6 m of the pickup pin (mean 42.8 m), comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius set by POL-NS-04(c). The rider's entitlement to the refund does not depend on this, because POL-NS-06 refunds on the shortfall regardless of presence, but it disposes of any no-show narrative built on the rider being somewhere else.

The chat log corroborates the premature termination in the driver's own words: the rider messaged 'wait ah, i coming liao' at 19:42:50, and the driver answered at 19:44:31 with 'cannot wait already ah, cancelling', nine seconds before the 19:44:40 cancellation, at a moment when the longest in-geofence run of 195 seconds was still 105 seconds short of the mandatory 300. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00203 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue code LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY — the rider's message is code-switched and genuinely contestable. That ambiguity goes only to whether the rider meant 'on my way' or 'already here'; on no reading does it add a single second to the driver's dwell, so the point survives the discount, and the cancellation timestamp it corroborates is independently carried by the unimpaired trip record.

No driver compensation is payable on this ruling. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; here POL-NS-01 fails at limbs (c) and (d) and POL-NS-06 applies directly to the shortfall, so the SGD 3.20 appearing in the fare breakdown's derived money block is not owed, and the SGD 4.00 belongs to the rider rather than to the driver.

The driver genuinely reached the pickup pin and stood there: the GPS trace shows 21 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for this zone class, with a closest approach of 18.7 m — far more than the 3 consecutive clean fixes POL-NS-02 demands — so arrival under POL-NS-02 is established on a clean, weight-1.0 trace and POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied.

The rider cannot take refuge in POL-NS-04. Limb (a) is not cleanly made out, because the only wait-window message, MSG-00203-002 ('wait ah, i coming liao'), is contested Singlish and the chat log is IMPAIRED at weight 0.85 with issue LANGUAGE_AMBIGUITY. Limb (b) fails outright: that message was sent at 19:42:50 and the driver replied at 19:44:31, 101 seconds later, inside POL-NS-04's 120-second window. This claim rests on the message timestamps, not on the contested wording, so it survives the 0.85 discount.

The arrival marker is not false. The 'arrived' event at 19:41:35 falls 15 seconds inside the driver's own stationary in-geofence run, so at the marker he was inside the 50 m radius and not moving; neither POL-NS-05 trigger — more than 300 m from the pin, or travelling at 15 km/h or above — is met, and no false-arrival referral arises against the driver.

The driver does not dispute the arithmetic that decides this case. His continuous in-geofence dwell was 195 seconds, 105 seconds short of the 300-second STANDARD minimum in POL-NS-01 limb (c), so the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable and POL-NS-06 requires that fee line to be refunded in full. The accumulation route under POL-NS-06 limb (i) is closed because the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00203-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), and no POL-NS-07 compensation can arise because that clause requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full. The driver's conduct was nonetheless diligent: he arrived at the pin, held position, and replied to the rider before cancelling, so nothing beyond the refund of the fee line is warranted.
